mapper.insert: insert into sys_item (create_by, create_time, update_time, project_id) VALUES (#{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{projectId})
mapper.update:
update sys_item set
create_by=#{item.createBy},
project_id=#{item.projectId},
create_Time=#{item.createTime},
update_Time=#{item.updateTime},
id=#{item.id} where id=#{item.id}
mapper.select: select si.id, si.create_by, si.create_time, si.update_time, si.project_id, (select sp.process from (select sp.* from sys_process sp where sp.is_process = 'YES') sp where sp.project_id = si.project_id group by sp.process order by process limit 1) as status, round((select sum(score) / count(*) from sys_score WHERE project_id = si.project_id group by project_id), 2) as score from sys_Item si
